styles.name: 彩色蜡笔
styles.subjects: fox-hooded girl with orange fox ears; sunflower-crowned druid with curly green hair; cheerful alchemist with round bronze goggles and wild pink hair; rabbit-eared messenger with a blue scarf; stout boar blacksmith with tusks and a leather apron; blue-haired mermaid with a shell crown; tiny mushroom-cap gnome with a round nose; friendly emerald baby dragon with little horns
styles.medium: colored wax crayon doodles with real coarse grain, uneven childlike strokes, warm expressive color, soft silhouettes, thick scratchy fills. Cute miniature fantasy busts, simple black vertical dot eyes. No hard black outlines
styles.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: avatar sprite atlas for a fantasy tabletop companion app. Primary request: Generate one coherent sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT brand-new, distinct character avatars in the 彩色蜡笔 style.
Canvas: 2:1 landscape, ideally 2048x1024. Exact uniform grid: FOUR columns and TWO rows of square cells. Every cell has one centered head-and-shoulders character. Place centers exactly at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=25%,75%. All eight share the same visual scale. Each complete silhouette occupies at most 70% of its square cell width and 72% of its height, with broad blank paper gutters. Characters must fit safely inside circular avatar crops. Absolutely no grid lines, no labels, no frames, no circles, no text, no watermark, no scenery. Uniform pale warm ivory backdrop #f8f5eb across the whole sheet.
Subjects in exact reading order, left to right, top row then bottom row: fox-hooded girl with orange fox ears; sunflower-crowned druid with curly green hair; cheerful alchemist with round bronze goggles and wild pink hair; rabbit-eared messenger with a blue scarf; stout boar blacksmith with tusks and a leather apron; blue-haired mermaid with a shell crown; tiny mushroom-cap gnome with a round nose; friendly emerald baby dragon with little horns.
Style/medium: colored wax crayon doodles with real coarse grain, uneven childlike strokes, warm expressive color, soft silhouettes, thick scratchy fills. Cute miniature fantasy busts, simple black vertical dot eyes. No hard black outlines.
Constraints: match the charming, very simple, tiny fantasy bust icon feeling of a mini-program avatar library. Strong different silhouettes. Each character should remain recognizable at 52px display size. The eight subjects must all be present once, with no duplicates. No generic wizard/princess/hooded assassin/knight repetition. Do not draw weapons outside the cells, do not overlap neighbors, no floating decorations between cells.
